factual_notes.fact: Baemin's official engineering report says the customer-facing multilingual version opened in February 2026 with English, Japanese, and Chinese.
Baemin's current App Store listing shows Korean plus three languages and documents pickup, selected no-minimum orders, regional restrictions, rider tracking, and 24-hour main support at 1600-0987.
Woowa Brothers announced that eligible overseas-issued Visa, Mastercard, JCB, and Amex cards could be used through Apple Pay on Baemin starting June 2, 2026.
Coupang Eats' current official store listings identify English support and describe pickup, real-time tracking, selected no-minimum one-item orders, and conditional WOW delivery benefits.
Coupang Eats lists 1670-9827 and eatshelp@coupang.com for support, and says optional camera access can be used for card scanning during payment-method registration.
The official Coupang Eats pages do not promise universal overseas-card acceptance or universal signup without Korean verification, so the article treats checkout as the authoritative test.
A Korean government briefing says delivery platforms may not disclaim all responsibility for faults such as missing food or delivery delays.
Food Safety Korea lists 1399 for reports about suspected unsafe or substandard food and requests supporting details and evidence.
